June 1, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Gluskin Sheff & Assoc Inc increased its stake in Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que (RY) by 854.25% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gluskin Sheff & Assoc Inc bought 694,443 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.00% with the market. The institutional investor held 775,736 shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $59.92M, up from 81,293 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gluskin Sheff & Assoc Inc who had been investing in Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $109.21B market cap company. The stock increased 0.05% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $75.63. About 55,279 shares traded. Royal Bank of Canada (NYSE:RY) has risen 9.18% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.39% the S&P500.
Old Mutual Global Index Trackers Ltd decreased its stake in Aramark (ARMK) by 97.24% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Old Mutual Global Index Trackers Ltd sold 476,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.96% with the market. The institutional investor held 13,517 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $535,000, down from 489,517 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Old Mutual Global Index Trackers Ltd who had been investing in Aramark for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.56 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.18% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $38.89. About 14,220 shares traded. Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) has risen 4.56% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.01% the S&P500.
Gluskin Sheff & Assoc Inc, which manages about $7.77 billion and $1.84B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Encana Corp (NYSE:ECA) by 962,486 shares to 2.61M shares, valued at $28.71M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Waste Connections Inc by 67,132 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 928,793 shares, and cut its stake in Manulife Finl Corp (NYSE:MFC).
